His own brothers sold him for twenty pieces of silver 💔 Genesis 37-50

A coat of many colors, a dream, an empty pit, slavery in Egypt, prison, and then Pharaoh's palace. When the famine hit, the brothers who sold him bowed down before him. And Joseph forgave them: “ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good” (Genesis 50:20).

Could you have forgiven them? Yes or no 👇

A giant with 24 fingers and toes. It's in the Bible. 😳

Hidden details #4: six fingers on every hand (2 Samuel 21:20), a borrowed iron axe head that floated (2 Kings 6:6), 153 fish counted after the resurrection (John 21:11), Samson and the jawbone (Judges 15:15), and the shortest verse in the Bible: “Jesus wept” (John 11:35).

Which one did you already know? Comment 1 to 5 👇

The bush was on fire, but it didn't burn up 🔥 Exodus 3

Moses was 40 years into a quiet life keeping sheep when God called from a burning bush: “Moses, Moses.” Holy ground, bare feet, and a mission to Pharaoh. Moses asked, “Who am I?” God answered with who He is: “I AM THAT I AM” (Exodus 3:14).

What's God calling you to that feels too big? 👇
